cart.title: Shopping cart
cart.signIn: Sign in to use your cart
cart.unavailable: Unavailable. Remove this item to continue to checkout.
cart.lastConfirmed: Showing the last confirmed cart. Reload before making more changes.
cart.failed: Cart request failed. Its outcome may be uncertain. Reload the cart before trying again.
cart.reconcileFailed: Your change was saved, but the cart could not be refreshed. Reload the cart; do not repeat the change.
cart.limit: Cart limits: 99 units per item, 50 configurations, 500 units total.
cart.unavailableError: This product or configuration is unavailable. Reload the cart and review your selection.
cart.missing: This cart item no longer exists. Reload your cart.
cart.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then reload the cart.

checkout.title: Demo Order Review
checkout.demo: Demo checkout only. No payment is collected and no shipping is arranged.
checkout.authoritative: Review your saved server cart. The server validates availability and confirms prices when placing the order.
checkout.recovery: An earlier submission needs confirmation. Retry the same order to recover its receipt. Keep this tab and do not change the cart: if the earlier request did not complete, retry purchases the current server cart.
checkout.uncertain: The response was lost or could not be confirmed. An order may already exist. Retry the same order; do not start another purchase.
checkout.conflict: This purchase key conflicts with a different order request. Submission is blocked. Ask the operator to check the existing order before attempting another purchase.
checkout.emptyRejected: The server rejected checkout because the cart is empty. Reload and review the cart before retrying.
checkout.invalidRejected: The server rejected the cart or SKU configuration. Reload the cart, correct unavailable items or limits, then retry the same order.
checkout.invalidCart: A valid, nonempty cart with available items is required. Review quantities and configurations.
checkout.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in to the same account in this tab to recover the same order.
checkout.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait before retrying the same order.
checkout.serverBusy: Checkout is busy. Wait, then retry the same order.
checkout.forbidden: This account cannot place the order. The purchase key has been retained.
checkout.storage: The saved purchase could not be read or safely stored. Submission is blocked. Restore browser storage and reload this tab; do not clear its data while an order may be unresolved.
checkout.cartRefreshFailed: The order is confirmed, but the cart could not be refreshed. Reload the cart; do not place this order again.
